class.name: GlyphFontMap
class.brief_description: Prompt glyph fonts and the tables that map inputs to their glyphs.
class.description: Holds glyph fonts plus glyph name to codepoint tables, grouped in named glyph sets ([code]"xbox"[/code], [code]"playstation"[/code], [code]"keyboard_mouse"[/code] ...). Every font uses the same codepoint for the same glyph, so a glyph string draws with whichever font holds its set, including a game font with the glyphs merged in. For pads, each [enum InputRouter.PadFamily] picks a set through [member family_sets], and [member pad_inputs] names one glyph per input slot in that set. [method get_input_glyph] combines the two. Set [member ProjectSettings.input_devices/router/glyph_map] to the resource's path. The InputRouter editor inspector, [method InputRouter.get_input_glyph], [method InputRouter.get_routes] and [method InputRouter.get_trace] use it. The resource is meant to be generated by a tool rather than edited by hand.

method.name: get_codepoint
method.description: Returns the codepoint of glyph [param glyph] in set [param set_id], or [code]0[/code] if either is missing.

method.name: get_default_font
method.description: Returns the font named by [member default_font_id], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_family_set
method.description: Returns the glyph set of [param family], an [enum InputRouter.PadFamily], from [member family_sets]. Empty if the family has none.

method.name: get_font
method.description: Returns the font with id [param font] from [member fonts], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_glyph
method.description: Returns glyph [param glyph] of set [param set_id] as a one-character [String], or an empty one if either is missing.

method.name: get_input_glyph
method.description: Returns the glyph of input slot [param input] (see [method InputRouter.button_input]) in the set of [param family], an [enum InputRouter.PadFamily]. Empty if the family has no set, the set names no glyph for the slot, or the glyph is missing.

method.name: get_set_input_glyph
method.description: Like [method get_input_glyph], for set [param set_id] named directly.

members.member: The id in [member fonts] of the font the editor and debug views draw with. It should hold every set [member family_sets] names.
The glyph set of each [enum InputRouter.PadFamily], indexed by the family's value.
Font id to a [PackedStringArray] of the sets that font holds.

Set id to a [PackedStringArray] with one glyph name per input slot, in slot order: the 21 [enum JoyButton] values, then three slots per [enum JoyAxis] (negative half, full axis, positive half), then the left and right stick. An empty name means no glyph.
Set id to a [Dictionary] of glyph name to codepoint.
